parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module is one cohesive application layer of use cases for the user/project/task domain. Every use case follows the same pattern: inject repository/IdGenerator abstractions, run execute(input), and return a DTO through the shared mappers in dtos.ts. The rule that a task must belong to its project lives in one place, TaskLookupService.getInProject, and both use cases that need it (AssignTaskUseCase, MarkTaskDoneUseCase) use it instead of reimplementing it. AddTaskUseCase and ListProjectTasksUseCase both repeat a short project-existence guard (findById + NotFoundError). This is a trivial null check with no project-lookup service being bypassed, so it doesn't count as duplicating an invariant that should live in one place. That is why confidence is somewhat reduced.
